title: The Gulf Dead Zone More Than Doubled Instead Of Shrinking
hook: The dead zone in the Gulf rebounded to 6,705 square miles instead of shrinking.
closing: Runoff upstream can leave sea life downstream without enough oxygen; cleaner water starts before the coast.
question: Who should pay to reduce farm runoff?

segments.say: The Gulf dead zone reached 6,705 square miles in the latest measurement. That more than doubled the previous measurement.
The reduction target is 1,900 square miles. The supplied recent average remains nearly double that goal.
Nitrogen loads reached 300% of their earlier level. The added fertilizer feeds algae whose decay consumes oxygen.
